title: TechOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence-streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.

Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit-ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.

Trusted by more than 400 customers-including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square-Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world s most innovative lenders do business.

As a TechOps (IT) Engineer, your role will be critical to maintaining a stable, reliable technical infrastructure. You will be responsible for monitoring the organizations systems, networks, and hardware to ensure they operate optimally and remain available to users.

What youll do:

  • Monitor and troubleshoot the organizations systems, networks, and applications to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, incidents, and outages to minimize downtime and ensure a seamless user experience.
  • Perform system administration tasks, including server configuration, maintenance, and upgrades.
  • Conduct software and asset inventory audits and take appropriate actions to protect the organizations infrastructure and data.
  • Develop the documentation, including system configurations, processes, and procedures.
  • Collaborate with external vendors and service providers to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and processes to improve system performance, scalability, and reliability.

What you will bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an IT Engineer
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Working experience in ticketing systems (Jira); networking systems like firewalls, switches, and servers (Squid/PXE); SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Jumpcloud, Cloudflare, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Windows, Linux environments, and scripting
  • Strong knowledge of systems administration, networking, and IT infrastructure
  • Comfortable working in shifts on a rotational basis to provide 24/7 support
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) is a plus.
  • Experience in handling CCTV and Biometrics is a plus.

Life at Ocrolus

We re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission - and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.

Our culture is grounded in four core values:
Empathy - Understand and serve with compassion
Curiosity - Explore new ideas and question the status quo
Humility - Listen, be grounded, and remain open-minded
Ownership - Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That s why we re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We look forward to building the future of lending together.

Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.

title: Delivery Lead Senior Manager
jobDescription:
Skill required: Financial Planning Analysis - Financial Planning and Analysis (FPA)

Designation: Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:16 to 25 years

What would you do The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a PL owner. Group Management information will include financial information and scenarios required for SOP meetings, H1 and FY targets. This will include challenging assumptions and coordination data inputs in all internal reporting systems, running the forecasting process activities, preparation and generation of financial information accurately and performing quality review with key finance senior stakeholders prior to releasing to the customer for approval. Drive independent analysis and provide insightful recommendations to the senior stakeholders. The objective of this role is to enable the Area Finance team to meet their business objectives by consolidating area financials, tracking actuals delivery vs budgets, providing key insights for Finance leadership team, as well as managing monthly dashboards and providing executive summary for Finance leadership team along with insights on key drivers. This role will partner senior stakeholders across various functional teams (Marketing Directors, Commercial Directors, Heads of Finance, Supply Chain Directors, etc) to provide strategic financial guidance on key financial performance in the market. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to, overseeing financial forecasts, industry value projections, regulatory impacts to the category, price war analysis, etc. The ideal candidate will proactively and collaboratively work across the organization to develop a competitor framework that can effectively be used as a platform to provide insights revenue and resource allocation and drive recommendations on potential course of action. This position requires an excellent knowledge of financials, strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and leadership skills. information

What are we looking for Knowledge, Experience Skills
  • Qualifications: CAs CFAs
  • 812 years of progressive finance experience
  • Proven track record in budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial analysis.
  • Experience in global FMCG / CPG / Tobacco industries or similar dynamic environments is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive process improvements.
  • Advanced Excel (macros, pivot tables, etc.), ERP systems (SAP), FPA tools, BI dashboards, Alteryx, Agentic AI, Lean Six Sigma, Tableau
  • Knowledge of FPA tools (SAP BPC, Hyperion, Anaplan,)
  • In-depth knowledge of PL, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow management.
  • Strong ability to convey financial information clearly to senior leadership.
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to handle large volumes of data accurately.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills; able to work across all levels and functions.
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and adapt to rapidly changing conditions.
  • Ability to proactively identify risk, perform sensitivity analysis and drive risk mitigation
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of rational decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Exposure to automation and digital transformation in FPA processes.

    Roles and Responsibilities:
  • Own / Lead the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
  • Conduct variance analysis on actual vs. budget/forecast, identify key drivers to the variances, analyze trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Develop financial models for scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and long-range forecasting to support strategic initiatives.
  • Deliver timely and accurate financial reports and dashboards, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence decision-making, optimize costs, and ensure resource allocation aligns with strategic priorities.
  • Drive efficiency through automation and implement best practices for FPA processes, reporting, and data accuracy.
  • Ensure adherence to financial policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements across all FPA activities.
  • Manage and mentor FPA analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.
  • Act as a vital member of the Consumer Leadership team in GBS, focusing on the Commercial Finance experience
  • Support the Consumer Delivery Lead in creating value across product categories
  • Present forecasts, performance, and potential risks/opportunities across all product lines including new categories and prepare strategies for senior stakeholders, considering competitor actions
  • Perform financial modelling, sensitivity, and scenario analysis to accurately reflect the impact of proposed changes on the operating results of the business and to support informed business decisions.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of regulatory change
  • Lead and coordinate efforts for process improvement and efficiency within the commercial finance team, providing timely insights
  • Undertake ad-hoc projects as needed
  • Contribute to developing integrated business strategies for portfolio, pricing, excise, and trade, considering all elements of the mix
  • Conduct competitor reviews and share key insights with Top Management, incorporating them into pricing and excise discussions
  • Establish governance and risk guidelines for pricing and excise activities to ensure strong controls and SOx compliance (where applicable)

jobDescription:
Skill required: Business Reporting Governance - Reporting Analytics

Designation: Measurement and Report Specialist

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:9 to 13 years

Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world-s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries.

What would you do
  • You own Generation Studio, the platform capability that turns a governed metric, a business question or a business problem into finished reports and decks. Generation Studio is one of the two AI experience surfaces that lead the build, and it is in from the proof of concept.
  • You build the pipeline that takes figures the deterministic engine has already computed and produces the executive summary decks and operational Excel outputs that delivery teams issue today, with the language model writing and assembling prose only, never computing a number.
  • You work to a firm boundary:the engine owns the arithmetic, the model owns the words, and every output clears the automated quality gate before it can be released.

    What are we looking for
  • Hands-on GenAI and LLM engineering experience taken through to production, not proof of concept only
  • Python
  • NLP, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector databases (pgvector)
  • Agentic orchestration
  • API development with FastAPI or Django
  • Report and document generation to Excel and PowerPoint outputs


    Roles and Responsibilities:
  • Own Generation Studio end to end, from the proof of concept through MVP and later waves
  • Build the generation pipeline that assembles reports and decks from pre-computed, governed figures
  • Enforce the numbers-to-prose boundary:the model narrates and assembles, it does not calculate
  • Integrate Generation Studio with the deterministic aggregation engine, the metric registry and the metadata catalog
  • Route every output through the automated QC and validation gate before release
  • Direct the Generation Studio developer, set the technical approach and review the work
  • Contribute prompt patterns, grounding methods and output templates back to the shared platform
  • Work with the solution architect as design authority and with the other AI and LLM lead on shared patterns

title: Lead Marketing Scientist
jobDescription:
About the Role

Lifesight is seeking a Lead Marketing Scientist to head a team of marketing scientists in developing advanced econometric and statistical models that solve complex marketing measurement problems. The role is anchored in scientific rigor and demands strong foundations in econometrics, causal inference, and statistical learning.

You will focus on building robust, interpretable, and scalable models - particularly in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) - while ensuring causal validity and statistical soundness. Beyond hands-on modeling, you will mentor a team of data scientists and shape the evolution of measurement methodologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Econometric Modeling MMM Development
  • Lead the design and implementation of Marketing Mix Models (MMM), formulating business problems as rigorous quantitative and statistical models.
  • Build models using regression-based approaches (linear and non-linear), time series methods for trend, seasonality, and forecasting, and Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks.
  • Incorporate core marketing science constructs, including adstock and lag effects, saturation and diminishing returns, and external drivers and control variables.
  • Ensure statistical robustness through proper model specification, parameter stability and interpretability, and sensitivity analysis.

Causal Inference Measurement Design
  • Apply causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and experimental and quasi-experimental designs.
  • Design and evaluate incrementality frameworks, including geo experiments and holdout testing.
  • Address endogeneity, confounding, and bias in observational datasets to ensure causal validity of model outputs.

Statistical Validation Diagnostics
  • Perform rigorous model validation, including residual analysis and diagnostics, multicollinearity checks, and out-of-sample and cross-validation.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics and ensure alignment with business outcomes.

Analytical Frameworks Model Integration
  • Develop integrated measurement frameworks that combine MMM, attribution, and experimentation.
  • Apply machine learning techniques where they enhance model performance without compromising interpretability.
  • Build scalable, reusable modeling approaches that strengthen the organization s measurement methodology.

Scientific Communication
  • Translate complex statistical outputs into structured, interpretable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Clearly articulate model assumptions, limitations, and implications, and support decision-making with evidence-based recommendations.

Team Leadership Capability Building
  • Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, establishing best practices in statistical modeling, code quality, and reproducibility.
  • Build team capability in advanced topics such as Bayesian modeling, causal inference, and experimental design.

Research, Delivery Collaboration
  • Stay current with advancements in econometrics, marketing science, causal inference, and statistical learning, and implement improved methodologies that enhance modeling accuracy and reliability.
  • Manage multiple analytical projects to defined timelines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure modeling outputs align with business needs.

Required Skills Experience
  • Experience: 8-12 years in advanced analytics, econometrics, or marketing science, with strong hands-on experience in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Technical expertise: Econometrics and regression modeling; time series analysis and forecasting; causal inference and experimental design; Bayesian statistics and hierarchical modeling (preferred).
  • Programming tools: Proficiency in Python or R, with strong experience in SQL and working with large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Master s or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience in marketing analytics or advertising measurement.
  • Exposure to SaaS-based analytics platforms.

Key Competencies
  • Strong quantitative and analytical reasoning, with scientific rigor and attention to detail.
  • Structured problem-solving and the ability to formulate ambiguous business questions as tractable statistical problems.
  • Clear, precise communication of technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to mentor and develop scientific talent.

What Success Looks Like
  • You create/help create statistically sound, interpretable MMM models delivered within Lifesight s methodology framework.
  • You Improve modeling efficiency by leveraging best-in-class AI to automate tasks and reduce manual effort.
  • You help create a high-performing, well-mentored team of marketing science professionals at lifesight.
  • Our clients are consistently satisfied and trust and act on our measurement insights.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.

About TylSemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

- Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.

- Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.

- IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

- India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

Were not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. Were building to win.

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. Youre not here to execute someone elses roadmap. Youre here to define it.

- Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesnt fly here.

- Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people whove shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.

- Low ego, high standards. We dont care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask

If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

Were asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Heres why you should:

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what were building.

- The team has done this before. Weve built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isnt our first rodeo.

- The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.

- The work is consequential. Youre not optimizing someones ad click-through rate. Youre building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

Role summary

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer s finance organisation actually uses.

What you will own Account technical ownership
  • Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.
  • Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact.
  • Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.
Solution design and architecture
  • Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
  • Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
  • Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.
Delivery leadership
  • Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it.

Advisory

  • Guide customers on governance, human oversight design, model risk and responsible AI.
Product and asset leadership
  • Convert deployment learnings into reusable assets: reference architectures, connector templates, evaluation packs and deployment accelerators.
  • Bring evidenced feedback to the product roadmap. Distinguish a single customer s preference from a genuine product gap.
What you bring
  • 6 to 10 years building and operating production systems, including at least two years in customer-facing delivery.

  • Two accounts running in production against agreed KPIs.

Our vision is to become the global standard for post-purchase intelligence, where logistics complexity never limits a brands growth.

Role Summary:
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) - Voice AI to build and scale ClickPosts centralized Voice AI platform.
ClickPost currently handles around 1 million outbound invoice calls per day and is expanding Voice AI across multiple use cases, including inbound conversations and additional communication channels. The centralized platform will power these use cases through a common infrastructure, allowing individual product teams to configure their prompts, workflows, and business logic without building the underlying Voice AI stack themselves.
You will work on the core platform responsible for Voice AI orchestration, quality, analytics, testing, iteration, scalability, and multi-channel support across Telephony, Web, and WhatsApp.

What You Will Do:
  • Build and scale the centralized Voice AI platform used by multiple ClickPost products and use cases.
  • Design and develop backend services for real-time voice conversations at scale .
  • Build Voice AI orchestration layers integrating LLMs, Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and telephony systems .
  • Work extensively with Voice AI frameworks and toolkits such as Pipecat .
  • Build reusable infrastructure that enables product teams to configure prompts, workflows, tools, and other Voice AI parameters.
  • Develop systems for conversation quality monitoring, analytics, testing, evaluation, and continuous improvement .
  • Enable Voice AI experiences across multiple channels including Telephony, Web, and WhatsApp .
  • Design systems for reliable deployment, monitoring, debugging, and scaling of Voice AI applications.
  • Optimize latency, reliability, cost, and conversation quality across the Voice AI stack.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to understand use cases and build platform capabilities that can support them at scale.

What You Will Need:
  • Strong hands-on experience in backend development and building production-grade backend systems.
  • Strong practical experience with Voice AI frameworks/toolkits , particularly Pipecat or similar frameworks .
  • Hands-on experience building Voice AI orchestration systems integrating LLMs, STT, and TTS.
  • Experience developing real-time conversational AI or voice-based applications .
  • Experience deploying and operating Voice AI applications in production environments.
  • Good understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, databases, and distributed systems .
  • Strong understanding of real-time communication, latency, concurrency, and reliability considerations in voice applications.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with an ability to take ownership of systems end-to-end.

Why Join ClickPosts Voice AI Team
  • Impact at Scale: Work on a platform already powering around 1 million outbound invoice calls every day, with significant expansion across use cases and channels.
  • Build the Core Platform: Your work will form the common Voice AI infrastructure used across multiple ClickPost products.
  • Solve Real-Time AI Problems: Work at the intersection of backend engineering, LLMs, speech technologies, telephony, and real-time systems.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Own critical platform capabilities from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring, quality, and scale.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Flexible working hours with Hybrid work arrangement.
  • Generous leave policy and time off.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Employee assistance program for mental health and well-being support.
  • Supportive and inclusive work culture promoting diversity and collaboration.

About the Role
Deccan AI is a venture-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.

  • Solid understanding of state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query, etc.)
  • Experience with canvas/SVG-based interactions (for image/video annotation tools) is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with performance optimization for large lists/datasets (virtualization libraries, memoization)
  • Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs and integrating with backend services
  • Good eye for UX; you care about reducing friction for end users, not just shipping features
  • Experience with component libraries and design systems
  • Bonus: experience with WebSockets/real-time features, accessibility (a11y), or prior work on annotation/labeling tools specifically
Nice to Have
  • Experience in AI/ML data pipelines or working with data labeling vendors/platforms
  • Familiarity with audio/video processing in-browser
  • Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright/Cypress)
Why Join Deccan AI
  • Work directly on tools that shape the quality of AI training data at scale
  • High ownership role, youll influence tool architecture and UX decisions from early on
  • Fast-paced, collaborative environment working closely with ML and ops teams

title: Full Stack React Application Developer
tagsAndSkills: analytics platforms,application developer,ai,analytics tools,aws lambda,azure devops,analytics,azure functions
jobDescription:
Job Summary

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

The Workday Solutions Manager leads the execution, development, and innovation of Workday across the enterprise. This role combines strategic leadership and hands-on technical expertise, ensuring Workday remains the organization s single source of truth for Human Capital, Finance, and Operations. The incumbent manages the Workday COE team, oversees integration lifecycle management, and drives automation, AI enablement, and orchestration initiatives to optimize business operations aligned to the company s vision and organizational objectives.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobDescription:
About Darwinbox
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1200+ global enterprises to manage their 4.5million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, JG Summit, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
Why Join Us
The way Darwinbox is evolving is unlike anything we have seen before. AI is transforming our platform, our customer experience, and the future of HR technology; this role will be at the forefront of turning that vision into reality. You will help bring our AI ambition to life in the field, working on high-impact problems with strategic customers while shaping how Darwinbox scales its next generation of intelligent products. This is the founding cohort of an entirely new function at Darwinbox the first FDEs will shape how the team operates, which customer engagements get the embedded model first, and how it scales. You will work zero layers removed from the customer and touch a stack broader than any pure product engineering role allows: the Darwinbox platform, Python at production scale, the LLM stack of your choice (Claude, GPT, Gemini), MCP servers, agent frameworks, and whatever the customer happens to run on their side.
Youll experience a culture of:
  • Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
  • Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
  • Continuous Learning and Professional Development
  • Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment
About the role
The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Darwinbox's most strategic enterprise customers to ship production-grade AI agents and Agentic Flows on the Darwinbox HCM platform inside each customer's environment. The role centres on three skill areas: production Python engineering for AI agents, deployment of LLM applications (prompt engineering at scale, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks), and architecting REST API and webhook integrations with payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, and ERP systems. You will work hands-on inside customer environments on HR workflow problems that exceed the platform's standard configuration surfaces.
What you will do
  • Embed with 23 strategic enterprise customers in parallel as the technical owner of the Darwinbox deployment in their environment.
  • Run discovery with CHROs, HRBPs, and HRIS leads to surface the real problem behind the stated ask and translate it into a working technical design.
  • Deliver a working prototype within ~1 week of engagement kick-off, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and channel field insights into the Darwinbox platform roadmap.
  • Design and ship production-grade AI agents on the Darwinbox platform for HR workflows including leave, performance, attendance, onboarding/exit automation, and HR decision support.
  • Architect custom integrations between Darwinbox and customer-side payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning platforms, and ERP stacks using REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven patterns.
  • Travel 2540 percent of the time to customer sites across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East as required.
What we are looking for
Required
  • Hands-on production Python engineering for enterprise SaaS, integrations, and AI agent development.
  • Production deployment of LLM applications: prompt engineering at scale, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
  • REST API and webhook integration design for systems interoperability (payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, ERP) with production-grade auth.
  • Customer discovery and technical translation with senior enterprise stakeholders (CHROs, HRBPs, HRIS leads).
  • Production LLM experience and willingness to travel 2540 percent candidates with only academic/demo AI exposure or hard travel constraints are unlikely to be the right fit.
Preferred
  • HCM domain knowledge across payroll, performance, attendance, talent, and recruitment workflows.
  • MCP server implementation or agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and AI observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse).
  • TypeScript or Java in addition to Python; multilingual capability across Hindi, English, or additional Indian / SEA languages.
  • Former technical founder experience, or experience in enterprise SaaS environments such as Salesforce (Agentforce), Atlassian, Databricks, Uniphore, UnifyApps, Sprinklr, Freshworks, Zoho, or similar settings with hands- on AI deployment work.
Experience and qualifications
